title: Resolution ladder: IndEgo pixel-26 at 480/360/240/180/120p
why: how far can encode resolution drop before the frozen 26-feature LOCO AUROC falls
hypothesis: AUROC stays within 0.02 of 480p down to 120p
method: re-encode each window libx264 crf23 -> decode 160x90 -> cpu_window_features 26 -> LOCO C=0.3 clip-bootstrap CI

title: OOD resolution sensitivity: frozen pixel-26 on Ego10K 1080p/480p/360p
data: Egocentric-10K OOD 60 windows (51 good/9 bad) human labels
method: NVDEC decode -> one-pass downscale -> frozen pixel-26 head -> AUROC + bootstrap CI

summary: Encoded resolution can drop to 180p (0.8428, 198 KiB) and 120p (0.8022, 137 KiB) with no AUROC loss vs 0.810 native; no knee down to 120p; all rungs within 0.02 (one CI).
Target met: CRF28=0.7960 (dAUROC -0.014) at 57% of CRF23 bytes; CRF33=0.7946 (-0.015) at 36%; no CRF broke 0.02.
360p@CRF28=0.8036 at 257 KiB (best bytes/accuracy, 40% of 480p@CRF23 bytes); 240p@CRF28=0.7934 at 169 KiB inside budget.
Pixel-26 OOD AUROC~0.43 (IndEgo head does not transfer) and is resolution-neutral: 480p d-0.002 [-0.026,+0.019], 360p d+0.013 [-0.034,+0.059]. EG2 view NOT recomputed.
